activity_summary: Gannet took you from Old Swan on the flood, twopence each, paid by each man. He has Raleigh crowned in Guiana already, and you did not correct him. He will land you at the outer stair and no further. If the tide turns while you are inside, Kemp will not pay it to turn back.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid his own fare and named the outer stair as the end of the ride.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Paid, sat first, and would not buy a tide that had turned.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Sat, and accepted the walk if the river changed.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Took three twopences, and no one further than the outer stair.

facets.activity: Paid twopence and heard Gannet on Raleigh

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: Twopence a man, and each man his own.

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: Crowned, and the gold already tired of being gold.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Outer stair at Whitehall, and no further.
